name: Custom (built from blocks)
summary: A Custom component has no baseline price of its own: its hard cost is the sum of the building blocks the user adds (each priced from data/research/_blocks with its own sources) plus any hand-priced items. Soft costs, contingencies, fees and financing use the shared norms in data/research/_common.

typicalSize.method: A custom component is one lump-sum assembly.

perPrimaryUnit.method: No baseline — the hard cost is the sum of the blocks added in the Custom builder.

scope.notes: Everything comes from the blocks the user adds.

systemSplit.method: Unused: a custom component has no baseline to split; each block carries its own division.

pctOfHard.method: The commercial/residential family totals in _common/soft-costs.json (totalSoftCostPctOfHard-*): 11–25%, mid 16% — a neutral blend for an unknown building.

softCosts.notes: Excludes impact fees, developer fee, financing and contingency, which the engine adds separately.

perPrimaryUnit.method: No range — a custom assembly has no comparable type.

openQuestions: None — a custom estimate is only as good as the blocks chosen; check each block's sources.
